_readme: Recorded from origin/dev on 2026-10-06 (Google spam policies: cloaking, sneaky redirects, back-button hijacking; CLAUDE.md §6.9 question 8). Checked by test/noCloakingNoHijack.test.ts.
userAgentReads: files allowed to read navigator.userAgent / platform / vendor, and how many times. Counts may only fall; a file that stops reading it must be deleted here.
why: the reason each read is legitimate. None of them changes the text, links or structured data a page serves — Googlebot and a browser get the same HTML.
History manipulation, popstate/beforeunload traps, script redirects, meta refresh, crawler-name sniffing and server-side user-agent reads have no allowlist: zero today, zero allowed.

why.components/site/MobileNav.tsx: Chooses how to offer 'install the app' in the mobile menu (iOS Safari has no install prompt, so it shows instructions). Client-only UI after hydration; page content is unchanged.
why.components/site/PwaInstallHint.tsx: Same install-hint choice for iOS Safari. Client-only; page content is unchanged.
why.lib/analytics.ts: deviceClass(): a coarse ios/android/desktop bucket for anonymous analytics events. Never affects what is rendered.
why.lib/download.ts: iOS Safari reads a blob URL late, so it is revoked after 10 s instead of 1.5 s. Download plumbing only.
why.lib/heic.ts: iOS decodes HEIC natively; skipping the WASM converter there avoids a Safari out-of-memory crash. Tool behaviour only.
why.lib/pipeline.ts: Caps the working image size on iOS/Android to stay inside mobile browser memory. Tool behaviour only.
why.lib/segmentation.ts: Picks the background-removal engine (WebGPU/WASM, model size) per device class to avoid mobile crashes. Tool behaviour only.
why.store/useToolStore.ts: Same device-class engine choice for the photo tool's background removal. Tool behaviour only.
